# CHIP-2025-03 test vectors

These are the test vectors of CHIP-2025-03 "Faster Blocks", which moves Bitcoin
Cash to 1-minute blocks in the May 2027 upgrade. They are copied unchanged
from the `tests/` directory of the CHIP repository at commit `9c4b023`:

    https://gitlab.com/0353F40E/fablous

Each subdirectory here has the name of its directory there. The vectors are
published under the MIT No Attribution license.
